values.binNote: No sheet data value for this window; it only appears in the wiki's description text (the empowered attack expires unused after 5 seconds).

mechanics.claim: Landing the empowered attack resets Kassadin's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Nether Blade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kassadin's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The 7-second cooldown does not start when W is cast; it starts only after the empowered attack resolves (post-effect), so casting W early and attacking later delays when it is next available.
The passive on-hit damage is classified as proc damage while the active empowered-attack damage is classified as spell damage, a distinction that matters for item/on-hit interactions.
mechanics.quote: The passive damage applies {{tip|proc damage}} and the active damage applies {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack still applies other on-hit effects and can critically strike normally, like an ordinary basic attack.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
